author: migueltenorio_attestant
content:
We are calling produceBlockV4 with include_payload=true to exercise self-building block only for the time being. 

Noted that avoiding the p2p stack is not desirable. We don't plan including any configurable pathway that allow Vouch operators to avoid the p2p stack intentionally. 

We are working atm on the mev part of epbs, which includes consuming the p2p bids.
